# Keel

> A token-driven design system for React, built so an AI coding tool can use it correctly
> without being told twice. Every color, size and duration comes from token files that are
> checked for contrast and consistency, and every rule is written down with the reason behind it.
> React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui on Base UI. MIT licensed, by Insperatio Designs LLC.

Read AGENTS.md first: it holds every rule, each with a one-line why, plus the definition of done.
Then read the rule file for the component you're about to use. If a rule doesn't cover your case,
follow its why.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the rules for building with Keel. 36 rules in six groups (color, type,
  space and layout, components, accessibility, tokens and files), anti-patterns, and what "done" means.
- [docs/QUICKSTART-AI.md](docs/QUICKSTART-AI.md): the five-minute version. What to read, what to run,
  and the ten mistakes that break a Keel build.
- [README.md](README.md): what Keel is, how to run it, and how the checks work.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each release, and what the checks caught while it was built.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): points Claude Code at AGENTS.md. No rules of its own.

## Commands

Prompts that walk a tool through a whole job, with the reading and the checks built in. Claude Code
picks them up as `/new-page` and `/add-component`; any other tool can be handed the file's contents.

- [.claude/commands/new-page.md](.claude/commands/new-page.md): build a page from Keel, decide its
  shape first, then prove it passes every check.
- [.claude/commands/add-component.md](.claude/commands/add-component.md): add a component, with its
  demo, its rule file and its checks. Starts by asking whether Keel needs it at all.
- [.claude/commands/audit.md](.claude/commands/audit.md): review code against Keel's rules. Runs the
  machine checks, greps for what a machine can catch, then judges what it can't, and reports with
  the rule and its why.
- [.claude/commands/new-theme.md](.claude/commands/new-theme.md): make a new brand from the one
  brand file, and prove it passes in both modes.

## Components

One file per component: when to use it, when to use something else, its props, numbered rules with
reasons, what accessibility is already handled, and good and bad examples.

- [App shell](docs/rules/app-shell.md): the frame every page sits in, and the page's one h1.
- [Field](docs/rules/field.md): one control with its label, help text and error, wired together.
- [Form](docs/rules/form.md): fields submitted together, each showing its own error.
- [docs/rules/button.md](docs/rules/button.md): actions on the page. One primary per group.
- [docs/rules/icon-button.md](docs/rules/icon-button.md): square icon-only button. `label` is required.
- [docs/rules/input.md](docs/rules/input.md): one line of text, always inside a Field with a visible label.
- [docs/rules/select.md](docs/rules/select.md): pick one of 3 to 15 options.
- [docs/rules/checkbox.md](docs/rules/checkbox.md): on/off saved with a form; groups and select-all.
- [docs/rules/switch.md](docs/rules/switch.md): a setting that applies the moment it changes.
- [docs/rules/badge.md](docs/rules/badge.md): short status label, never clickable, never accent.
- [docs/rules/tabs.md](docs/rules/tabs.md): 2 to 7 views of one object, not steps and not navigation.
- [docs/rules/card.md](docs/rules/card.md): everything about one object; clickable via `CardTitle href`.
- [docs/rules/table.md](docs/rules/table.md): rows with the same columns; sorting, selection, empty state.
- [docs/rules/dialog.md](docs/rules/dialog.md): a focused task; AlertDialog for destructive confirmations.
- [docs/rules/toast.md](docs/rules/toast.md): short message about what just happened.
- [docs/rules/_template.md](docs/rules/_template.md): the shape every rule file follows.

## Tokens and brands

- [docs/brand.md](docs/brand.md): how one brand file makes a whole new brand, and what it controls.
- [docs/figma.md](docs/figma.md): how Figma and the repo stay in sync, and how drift is caught.
- [Before and after](docs/before-after.md): the same page built with and without the system, and what the checks found in each.

## Optional

- [src/demo/SettingsPage.tsx](src/demo/SettingsPage.tsx): a realistic page built only from Keel.
  Copy its patterns.
- [src/components/ui/](src/components/ui/): the components. The comment at the top of each file is
  its usage guide.
- [scripts/](scripts/): the token build and the checks that enforce all of the above.
